name: Technical Design Report for the Paul Scherrer Institute Experiment R-12-01.1 (MUSE)

summary.plain: The design report for the MUSE experiment at the Paul Scherrer Institute, which scatters muons and electrons from protons to study the proton radius puzzle.
summary.technical: MUSE technical design report (PSI R-12-01.1): simultaneous mu p and e p elastic scattering with both beam polarities on the pi M1 beamline.
